note: Model weights the sidecar downloads at first use. They are not in the repo (BiRefNet is ~928 MiB) and rembg fetches them to ~/.rembg/ with no integrity check of its own. Pinned by sha256 here on the same principle as footage-by-hash: Block 10's definition of done is a golden run green on two machines, and an unpinned model means machine #2 can produce different mattes from identical input with nothing in the repo able to explain it. Verify with tools/cv/verify-models.sh.
